title: 第 19 章 圣女问询一语点醒第 20 章 探寻禁地深谷残道
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 傍晚的夕阳把天边染成了暖红色，晚霞透过墓园的枯树，洒下细碎的金光，把那些歪歪扭扭的旧坟，都染成了温柔的橘色。风里带着前山桂树的香，混着坟地的冷意，奇奇怪怪的，却不讨厌，反而让整个墓园都软了下来。
林寂刚把窝棚的破木板修好，昨天赵峰他们来的时候，把他的窝棚踹塌了，他忙活了一下午，才把那些木板拼回去，刚擦了擦手上的泥，就听到了一阵极轻的脚步声。
很轻，很柔，不是那些执法弟子的沉步，也不是赵峰他们的乱步，是他熟悉的，苏清砚的脚步。
林寂的动作顿了一下，抬头看向入口，就看到素白的裙角，从荒草后面露了出来，苏清砚左右看了看，确认没人之后，才轻手轻脚的走了进来，头发被风吹得有点乱，额前的碎发贴在脸上，看起来比平时少了点圣女的清冷，多了点少女的局促。
她看到林寂，眼睛亮了一下，然后又有点不好意思的笑了笑，脚步放得更轻了，走到他面前，停了下来。
夕阳的光落在她的脸上，把她的睫毛染成了金红色，她手里攥着一个蓝布包，手指有点白，看得出来，她有点紧张。
林寂站在原地，看着她，半天都没说出话来。
他没想到，她居然会主动来找他。
之前她都是远远的看着他，帮他，从来没有这么近的，主动来找他说话。
“你...你没事吧？”苏清砚先开了口，声音很轻，带着点担心，“昨天赵峰的事，我听说了，他没把你怎么样吧？”
林寂愣了一下，才反应过来，摇了摇头，声音有点干：“我没事，他已经走了。”
“那就好。”苏清砚松了口气，笑了笑，然后她把手里的蓝布包递了过来，“这个...给你的。”
林寂接过那个布包，有点沉，他打开看了看，里面是一个新的白瓷瓶，还有一本泛黄的古籍，封面上写着《残道拾遗》四个字，字已经磨得模糊了。
“这是...”林寂抬头看她，有点疑惑。
“这个净气丹，是我新炼的，比上次的更好，能帮你稳住封印，还能帮你炼化朽气。”苏清砚挠了挠头，有点不好意思的说，“还有这本古籍，是我在藏书楼找到的，里面记载了一点关于残道的事，我想...你可能用得上。”
林寂的心里，瞬间就暖了。
他没想到，她居然为他做了这么多，特意去藏书楼给他找古籍，还特意给他炼丹药，她一个圣女，每天那么忙，居然还想着他的事。
他张了张嘴，想说谢谢，但是话到嘴边，却又说不出来了，他只是看着她，眼睛有点热。
苏清砚被他看得有点不好意思，转过头，看向墓园深处的山谷，脸色慢慢的严肃了起来：“林寂，我今天来，还有一件事要提醒你。”
林寂点了点头，看着她。
“后山深处，比你想的还要危险。”苏清砚的声音轻了下来，带着点认真，“我昨天回去查了古籍，那个山谷，是上古时候的战场，里面不仅有煞灵王，还有很多上古的残道碎片，还有...天道的封印，比你想的要厉害得多。”
她顿了顿，看着他，眼神里满是关切：“你之前吸收了那个残道碎片，虽然有我的净气丹帮你压制，但是还是有一点气息泄露了，我怕...天道会察觉到，还有李长老，他虽然这次罚了赵峰，但是他肯定不会善罢甘休的，他肯定还会找你的麻烦，你要小心。”
林寂看着她，点了点头：“我知道了，谢谢你。”
“不用谢我。”苏清砚摇了摇头，看着他，“我只是...不想你出事。”
她的声音很轻，却带着一点不易察觉的温柔，落在林寂的耳朵里，暖得他心里都化了。

The setting sun in the evening dyed the horizon a warm red color. The sunset shined through the dead trees in the cemetery and cast a fine golden light, dyeing the crooked old graves a gentle orange color. The wind carried the fragrance of the laurel trees on the front mountain, mixed with the coldness of the cemetery. It was strange, but not annoying. Instead, it made the entire cemetery soften.
Lin Ji had just repaired the broken wooden boards of the shack. When Zhao Feng and the others came yesterday, they kicked his shack down. He worked all afternoon to put the wooden boards back together. As soon as he wiped the mud from his hands, he heard the sound of very light footsteps.
It was very light and soft. It was not the heavy steps of those law enforcement disciples, nor the random steps of Zhao Feng and the others. It was the footsteps of Su Qingyan that he was familiar with.
Lin Ji paused for a moment, looked up at the entrance, and saw the hem of her plain white skirt peeking out from behind the grass. Su Qingyan looked around to make sure no one was there, and then walked in quietly. Her hair was a bit messy in the wind, and the strands of hair on her forehead stuck to her face. She looked a little less cold as a saint and more cramped as a girl than usual.
When she saw Lin Ji, her eyes lit up, then she smiled a little sheepishly, her steps became lighter, she walked to him and stopped.
The light of the setting sun fell on her face, dyeing her eyelashes golden red. She was holding a blue cloth bag in her hand, and her fingers were a little white. It was obvious that she was a little nervous.
Lin Ji stood there, looking at her, without saying a word for a long time.
He didn't expect that she would come to him.
She had always watched him and helped him from a distance before, but she had never been so close and took the initiative to talk to him.
"Are you...are you okay?" Su Qingyan spoke first, her voice was very soft and a little worried, "I heard about Zhao Feng yesterday. He didn't do anything to you, right?"
Lin Ji was stunned for a moment before reacting. She shook her head and said in a dry voice, "I'm fine. He's gone."
"That's good." Su Qingyan breathed a sigh of relief and smiled, then she handed over the blue cloth bag in her hand, "This... is for you."
Lin Ji took the cloth bag, which was a bit heavy. He opened it and took a look. Inside was a new white porcelain bottle and a yellowed ancient book. On the cover were written the four words "Collections of the Lost Way". The words had been worn out and blurred.
"This is..." Lin Ji looked up at her, a little confused.
"This Purification Pill is a new one I made. It's better than the last one. It can help you stabilize the seal and refine the decayed energy." Su Qingyan scratched his head and said a little embarrassedly, "There is also this ancient book that I found in the library. It records a little bit about Can Dao. I think... you may need it."
Lin Ji's heart instantly felt warm.
He didn't expect that she actually did so much for him, went to the library to find ancient books for him, and even made elixirs for him. She was a saint, so busy every day, but she still thought about him.
He opened his mouth, wanting to say thank you, but when the words reached his lips, he couldn't say them. He just looked at her, his eyes a little hot.
Su Qingyan felt a little embarrassed by him. He turned his head and looked at the valley deep in the cemetery. His face slowly became serious: "Lin Ji, I am here today, and there is one more thing I want to remind you."
Lin Ji nodded and looked at her.
"The depths of the back mountain are more dangerous than you think." Su Qingyan's voice became softer and more serious. "I went back yesterday to check the ancient books. That valley was a battlefield in ancient times. There were not only evil spirit kings in it, but also many fragments of ancient fragments, and... the seal of heaven, which is much more powerful than you think."
She paused and looked at him, her eyes full of concern: "You absorbed the residual Dao fragment before. Although my Qi Purification Pill helped you suppress it, a little breath was still leaked. I'm afraid... Heavenly Dao will notice it, and Elder Li. Although he punished Zhao Feng this time, he will definitely not let it go. He will definitely find trouble for you. You have to be careful."
Lin Ji looked at her and nodded: "I understand, thank you."
"No need to thank me." Su Qingyan shook her head and looked at him, "I just... don't want anything to happen to you."
Her voice was very soft, but with a hint of imperceptible tenderness. It fell in Lin Ji's ears and was so warm that his heart melted.
